S1037.reason: A lawful assignment carries the buyer’s right to specific performance of a land contract, and a zoning change that merely raises value is not an unmarketable-title defect.

S0107.reason: Immunity ratione personae attaches only to certain high officials while in office and covers both private and official acts.

S0341.reason: Normal resting adult respiration is about 12–20 breaths per minute, so 14–16 is the normal range.
